arguments.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a gas boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat it as urgent tonight. Please: 1) Get everyone out of the flat now, including your flatmate's mum (82), who should go out first with help. 2) Don't use light switches, flames, or the boiler. If it's safe, open doors and windows on your way out. 3) Once outside, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). Call 999 if anyone feels unwell. 4) Is your kitchen CO alarm sounding? Does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? 5) Please reply to confirm everyone is out. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer out tonight to make it safe. Please don't go back in until they or the gas emergency service say it's safe.
